v2_origin.extracted_from: boundary-3d.js Phase A/B/C (commit 0f35b9f, 2026-04-25), then split in v3: Phase A + class filter to v7-boundary-topology, Phase B + C here

summary: Builds the heavy signal layers of the roof-graph for each surviving plane: ray-cast nearby projections (Phase B), per-plane signal grids (open-angle, CoM-distance, balance — Phase C), and the unified corner pool. RI corners are re-derived from upstream RIDGE_LINES (closest-approach + dedup); concave/convex anchors are detected as local maxima of the OA directional gradient on the group and nearby grids. Consumes the topology TLV and emits boundary-signals-roof-graph with CORNERS (RI + concave/convex), NEARBY_PROJECTIONS, and PLANE_GRIDS appended.

phases.name: Ridge-intersection corner re-derivation
phases.description: Walks every pair of upstream RIDGE_LINES that share a plane; computes line-line closest-approach midpoint, gates on closest-approach distance ≤ cornerDistThreshold and a per-side margin test, then sorts by ascending dist and dedups within cornerMergeThreshold, accumulating plane/ridge id sets per pool entry. Replaces the bench-v2 detectCorners() call that ran in Phase A.

phases.name: Per-plane setup
phases.description: For each surviving plane g (rejected=false, ≥6 group points): fit equation, build basis, project group points onto (u, v); build a uniform-grid bucket index over (u, v) at NEARBY_RADIUS cell size for O(1) point-in-disc tests.

phases.name: Nearby projections — tile-wide beam ray-cast
phases.description: Single tile-wide pass: for each tile point p with beam direction b, ray-cast t = -(n·p + d)/(n·b) onto every alive plane (skip own group, skip t≥0 or |denom|<1e-6); keep hits whose (u, v) sit within nearbyRadius of g's group bucket. ALL hits are kept in the pool for anchor-validation proximity tests; the |signedDist|≥planeDistFilter filter is applied only when feeding the nearby signal grid (per bugfix 94b7866). Emitted as the NEARBY_PROJECTIONS section.

phases.name: Group signal grid (computeSignalGrids on group points)
phases.description: Per plane, cell-by-cell on a (u,v) grid of grid_cell_size on the tilted plane: for each cell node, gather group points within grid_eval_radius — compute open-angle (OA) = 2π − filled angular span seen from the node, CoM-distance, outward-direction (oU/oV), best-left/best-right neighbour angular offsets, point count. Then a post-pass computes the OA directional gradient (max |OA(±a)−OA(∓a)| over 4 opposite-pair offsets) into oaSpanField — this is the corner-detection signal.

phases.name: Nearby signal grid (computeSignalGrids on |sd|≥planeDistFilter nearby points)
phases.description: Same kernel as C.grid.group but fed the filtered nearby projections (keeps only |signedDist|≥planeDistFilter to drop in-plane noise). Produces a second grid with its own bbox/dims; both grids cover the same (u,v) plane but their headers are independent on the wire (see v3 divergence on NEARBY_FIELD as second PLANE_GRIDS record).

phases.name: Balance field
phases.description: Per-cell blend of group-CoM and nearby-CoM with point-count trust weighting (MIN_PTS_FULL_TRUST=5; below-trust cells blend toward REF_COM_DIST≈0.424m) plus an opposition reward (−(gOut·nOut)) that rewards anti-aligned outward directions on opposite sides of an edge. Falls back to a one-sided form when only the group cell has data. Gates anchor validation downstream (anchorBalanceMin).

phases.name: Concave/convex anchor synthesis
phases.description: Find local maxima of oaSpanField (5×5 neighbourhood, local_max_half_window=2) with span ≥ angularSpanMinDeg. At each peak, pick the neighbour cell with the largest OA, read its outward direction + best-left/best-right offsets, and emit two outgoing edge directions in tile-world basis. Dedup within anchorDedupRadius (0.4m). Anchors from the group grid get source='concave'; anchors from the nearby grid get source='convex'.

phases.name: Anchor validation
phases.description: For each candidate anchor: must have at least one group point within anchorValidRadius of (u,v), at least one nearby point within anchorValidRadius, and balField at the anchor's cell ≥ anchorBalanceMin. Anchors failing any gate are dropped (debug reason: 'no group within 0.5m' / 'no nearby within 0.5m' / 'balance B < threshold').

phases.name: Pool assembly + naming
phases.description: RI corners (named RI<n>) are pushed first into the pool, then surviving concave anchors (P<g>C<n>) and convex anchors (P<g>X<n>) per plane. Each concave/convex pool entry carries dirsByPlane (two outgoing edge dirs per plane) and a cached comBisectorByPlane (CoM-direction blended bisector, derived from groupField.outU/V minus nearbyField.outU/V at the anchor's grid cell) so v7-boundary-polygons can skip its D.4 recompute.

parameters.name: nearbyRadius
parameters.summary: Disc radius for keeping a ray-cast hit as a nearby projection (Phase B.gather).
parameters.rationale: Wide enough to cover the typical eave-overhang / facade-offset distance that puts neighbour-plane points just outside the group's bbox, narrow enough to keep the per-plane projection pool tractable (~hundreds of items per plane on dahouet).

parameters.name: planeDistFilter
parameters.summary: Min |signedDist| for a nearby projection to be fed into the nearby signal grid (NOT used at gather time).
parameters.rationale: Drops in-plane projection noise (points that lie almost on the plane don't add new edge evidence). Crucially, this filter is applied ONLY when building the nearby-grid input — the full unfiltered pool is kept for anchor validation's 'no nearby within 0.5m' proximity check (per bugfix 94b7866).

history.note: Fixed regression where filter was applied at gather time, dropping ~108 items/plane and causing P5 'no nearby within 0.5m' rejections to spike 4→15 on dahouet.

parameters.name: cornerDistThreshold
parameters.summary: Max ridge-ridge closest-approach distance for an RI corner candidate.
parameters.rationale: Two ridges sharing a plane that pass within 1m are assumed to meet (the gap is geometric noise from independent plane fits). Beyond 1m they're treated as parallel/skew, no corner emitted.

parameters.name: cornerMergeThreshold
parameters.summary: Dedup radius for RI corners (a node where 3+ ridges meet collapses to one entry).
parameters.rationale: Three ridges meeting at a true vertex generate three pairwise intersection points within a few cm of each other; 25 cm absorbs them while staying tight enough that adjacent corners on the same plane don't merge.

parameters.name: anchorDedupRadius
parameters.summary: Per-plane dedup radius for concave/convex anchors after corner synthesis.
parameters.rationale: OA-gradient local maxima can fire on multiple adjacent cells of a single feature (cellSize=10 cm); 40 cm collapses adjacent peaks while keeping distinct corners of a small dormer apart. Sorted by span descending so the strongest peak wins.

parameters.name: anchorValidRadius
parameters.summary: Proximity radius for anchor-validation 'no group within R' / 'no nearby within R' gates.
parameters.rationale: Anchor must sit close to BOTH a group point and a nearby projection — otherwise it's floating in empty space (group-only) or has no edge evidence (nearby-only). 50 cm is generous enough not to kill legitimate corners on sparse roofs.

parameters.name: anchorBalanceMin
parameters.summary: Min balField value at an anchor's cell for it to survive validation.
parameters.rationale: Balance < 0.25 means the corner is either CoM-unbalanced (one side empty) or its group/nearby outward directions are not anti-aligned — both signal a non-edge cell. 0.25 trades off recall vs. false-corner suppression; empirically tuned on dahouet.

parameters.name: gridCellSize
parameters.summary: Signal-grid cell size on the tilted plane.
parameters.rationale: 10 cm matches typical IGN LAZ point spacing — finer cells produce mostly-empty cells with noisy CoM; coarser cells smear corners across multiple cells. Drives memory: largest plane on dahouet ≈ 100×100 cells.

parameters.name: gridEvalRadius
parameters.summary: Disc radius for per-cell signal evaluation (open-angle, CoM gathering).
parameters.rationale: Large enough to sample several points per cell on typical density (~10 pts/m²), small enough that an edge crosses ≤ 1 disc width so the OA collapse is well-localized at the boundary.

parameters.name: angularSpanMinDeg
parameters.summary: Min OA-gradient span for a cell to qualify as a corner-detection local-maximum candidate.
parameters.rationale: Below 150° the OA neighbourhood is too gradual to be a sharp corner — typically just a smooth edge. 150° matches the rule of thumb that a true corner produces an OA flip of ≥ a half-turn between opposite-pair neighbours.

parameters.name: localMaxHalfWindow
parameters.summary: Half-window for the local-maxima sweep on oaSpanField (5×5 when half=2).
parameters.rationale: Wider than anchorDedupRadius/cellSize (4 cells = 40 cm) so the sweep itself filters most adjacent firings; dedup is a secondary backstop.

parameters.name: minPlanePts
parameters.summary: Min group point count to keep a plane alive for Phase B/C.
parameters.rationale: Matches v7-boundary-topology's plane-fit minimum. Below 6 points the basis is too noisy to seed a useful grid.

parameters.name: upAxis
parameters.rationale: v3 production LAZ is z-up; bench-v2's synthetic test cases are y-up. Only affects fall-back beam direction when bi-directions artifact is missing (vertical default).

reads.name: bi-directions
reads.description: Tile-wide F32×3·N beam direction per point. Optional — without it, Phase B falls back to a vertical default (0,-1,0 or 0,0,-1 per upAxis) and emits a degraded pool.

reads.name: building-local-frames
reads.description: Per-building centroid (cx, cy, cz) for the building-local shift.

reads.name: grm-owner
reads.description: Per-building Int16 owner array (which plane each point belongs to after grow-refit-merge).

reads.name: boundary-topology-roof-graph
reads.description: Per-building TLV — PLANES, RIDGES, RIDGE_LINES (with has_line + has_side bits). Phase A + class filter already applied.

reads.name: ts-weights
reads.description: Per-building F32 per-point density weight (Voronoi cell area π·d_k²/k) from v7-tile-signals. Wired 0c3e28a (2026-05-28); used to DENSITY-WEIGHT the group-UV rasterise that drives the marching-squares contour (physical-area estimation — endorsed by the selective-weighting rule). Nearby-point weight is calibrated to the mean own-point weight (impl.c:1359-1376) so the per-cell contest stays count-based, not weight-magnitude-based (avoids the ~180× weight-variance bias). REQUIRED when n_pts_local>0.

reads.name: bldg-thresholds
reads.description: Per-building density (+ spacing, z_noise, dist thresholds) from v7-derive-thresholds. Only lidar_density is consumed per-bldg: it scales the contour cell-size. Mandatory — using full-tile density instead would mis-scale by √(tile_area/bldg_area) (≈1.4× on dahouet).

writes.name: boundary-signals-roof-graph
writes.description: Per-building TLV with upstream sections (PLANES, RIDGES, RIDGE_LINES) passed through verbatim, plus appended sections: CORNERS (0x06) with RI + concave/convex pool entries (dirsByPlane + comBisectorByPlane on anchors), NEARBY_PROJECTIONS (0x04) per-plane, PLANE_GRIDS (0x05) with up to two records per alive plane (GROUP_FIELD+BAL_FIELD, NEARBY_FIELD).

v3_divergences.topic: Split from monolithic v2 boundary-signals: Phase A + class filter moved to v7-boundary-topology
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 boundary-signals did Phases A (adjacency + ridges + roof-graph pre-pass), B (nearby gather), C (signal grids + anchors) in one step. v3 splits A out into v7-boundary-topology so the cheap topology + class filter can stand alone (and be reused by future pipelines); v7-boundary-signals consumes its TLV and adds the heavy Phase B + C layers.

v3_divergences.topic: PLANE_ANCHORS section dropped, anchors folded into CORNERS
v3_divergences.rationale: PLANE_ANCHORS was a redundant projection of CORNERS — iterating CORNERS with source∈{4,5} and planeId∈planeIds yields the same per-plane anchor view. Section id 0x08 is now reserved with a forward-compat note in ROOF-GRAPH-FORMAT.md §4.8. CORNERS gained the dirsByPlane subrecord (flag bit 0x04) to carry the two outgoing edge directions previously stored in PLANE_ANCHORS.

v3_divergences.topic: NEARBY_FIELD added as a second PLANE_GRIDS record per plane
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 only stored GROUP_FIELD on the wire — nearby field was recomputed downstream as needed. v3 emits NEARBY_FIELD as a second PLANE_GRIDS record (same plane_id, independent dims/origin in its own header, flag bit 0x02) alongside the GROUP_FIELD+BAL_FIELD record (bits 0x01|0x04). pack_plane_grid_record was refactored into pack_one_grid_record so both records share schema. ROOF-GRAPH-FORMAT.md §4.5 was updated to drop the stale 'NEARBY_FIELD same shape as GROUP_FIELD' claim.

v3_divergences.topic: Nearby gather no longer applies planeDistFilter at collection
v3_divergences.rationale: Phase B was applying |sd|≥planeDistFilter (0.20m) at gather time, dropping ~108 items per plane that v2 keeps for anchor-validation proximity checks. v2 keeps ALL items in pd.nearbyItems (boundary-signals.js#L668-672 unconditional push) and only filters when feeding the nearby signal-grid input. Fix moved the filter to the Phase C call site.

v2 boundary-polygons recomputes the CoM-direction blended bisector in its D.4 phase by re-reading groupField.outU/V and nearbyField.outU/V at the anchor's cell. v3 caches the result on the corner record (flag bit 0x20) so v7-boundary-polygons can skip the recompute and v7-boundary-regularize can reuse it for nudge directions.

v3_divergences.topic: Building-local compute frame with F64 shift in headers
v3_divergences.rationale: v3 unshifts upstream PLANES (d_local = d_world + n·c) and RIDGE_LINES (line_point − c) into the building-local frame for compute, then the wrapper re-shifts emitted positions back to tile-world before packing. PLANE_GRIDS headers now carry building_centroid (F64×3) so the JS renderer can apply the shift at render time — an earlier attempt that pre-shifted nodeX/Y/Z to tile-world in F32 collapsed near L93 (~289550) to ~3 cm and produced a visible staircase artifact on heat-map cells.

v3_divergences.topic: Corner names emitted on the wire (RG_CORNER_HAS_NAME flag)
v3_divergences.rationale: v2's nameFor() naming convention (RI<n>, P<g>C<n>, P<g>X<n>) ported to v3 — emitted via CORNERS flag bit 0x01 + padded-string convention. Surfaced in the lab UI corner-inspector and used by the v3 regression baseline diff at v3/tests/baselines/v7-boundary-signals/dahouet/.

related.summary: The roof-graph pre-pass introduced into boundary-3d (later extracted into bench-v2 boundary-signals, then split between v3 v7-boundary-topology + v7-boundary-signals). Establishes the snapshot-viz pattern.

Review of the wrong-side-corner-killing problem in downstream boundary-corners D.2b. Relevant here because v7-boundary-signals produces the convex anchors that D.2b filters — the meta-critique notes D.2b is treating an upstream symptom this step could address (e.g., plane-interior weighting in anchor synthesis).
v2: extract Phase A/B/C from boundary-3d into a standalone boundary-signals step (1046 LOC). Origin point for the v3 port.
v3 first pass: RI corners + Phase B nearby gathering. PLANE_GRIDS and concave/convex anchors deferred.
v3 Phase C: signal grids + concave/convex corners + (then) PLANE_ANCHORS.
v3 PLANE_GRIDS first slice: balance-only on the wire + heat-map viz.
v3 richer PLANE_GRIDS: GROUP_FIELD wire emit (10×f32 + u16 per cell), drop dirs metadata block. dahouet PLANE_GRIDS 884KB→10MB.
Align ptCount u16 array in the GROUP_FIELD block — fixed ASan abort + cache mismatch.
Corner names (RI<n>, P<g>C<n>, P<g>X<n>) on the wire + dahouet regression baseline (corners, plane-anchors, summary).
Drop PLANE_ANCHORS section; re-enable dirsByPlane on CORNERS; add comBisectorByPlane cache.
Restore unfiltered nearby items for anchor_valid proximity check — move planeDistFilter from Phase B gather to Phase C nearby-grid feed.
NEARBY_FIELD as second PLANE_GRIDS record + lab UI heatmap layers for groups OA gradient, nearby OA, nearby OA gradient. (Bundled with topology has_side fix.)
Wire format spec for the three sections this step writes plus the PLANE_ANCHORS history note.
Phase 5.7 v7 port roadmap: where v7-boundary-signals sits in the v3 chain and what was deferred/cleared up to this step.
Regression baseline (corners.json, summary.json) checked in 2026-05-11 — run v3/tests/run-v7-bs-bench-regression.py to diff.

open_questions: Should anchor synthesis weight OA-gradient by a plane-interior consistency signal (e.g., side-vec sign) to suppress wrong-side convex anchors upstream of boundary-corners D.2b? See related journal 2026-05-17.
PLANE_GRIDS payload is heavy (10 MB on dahouet at the GROUP_FIELD richness level). Should there be a `emitPlaneGridsHeavy` param to gate the 10×f32 fields when downstream only needs balance?
NEARBY_FIELD currently has independent bbox/dims from GROUP_FIELD. Is there a downstream consumer that actually needs nearby's heat maps, or is the second record viz-only and could be gated?
anchor validation's anchorBalanceMin=0.25 threshold is empirically tuned on dahouet — what is its false-positive / false-negative rate across the bench corpus?
RI re-derivation in this step duplicates the work topology has already done implicitly (RIDGES + RIDGE_LINES carry plane_a/plane_b). Could topology emit RI corners directly and this step skip RI?
